title: 第15章 侍奉人皇的少女荒古第一女帝第16章 坏了我好像把无始整没了
slug: 遮天刚成天帝聊天群什么鬼
content_zh:
太古时代。
人皇诞生于北斗葬帝星。
他在人族最绝望的时代中崛起，同修阴阳两道，演化后天混沌体，仅仅只用了四百余年，便一举登临至高，在万众瞩目之下证道人皇之位——
至此。
北斗人族彻底崛起。
他们将人皇视为无上神明。
整个北斗四处都修建了人皇庙宇，哪怕到了如今的荒古时代，人皇的信仰依旧无人能够撼动。
在北斗人族的心中——
人皇就是神！
某一座人皇庙宇。
一名宛若精灵般的少女正在打扫着庙宇中的一切，她身着一袭白裙，身姿婀娜挺秀，高挑纤细，肌肤白腻，一双清冽的眼眸中似有无尽星光闪烁，浑身散发着一股独特的气质……
隐约间。
少女仿佛与大道相合。
她的一举一动都散发着难以言喻的气息，时刻与大道贴合，在冥冥之中引来了天地精气的亲近。
“小盈。”
庙宇外走进了一名端庄美妇人。
她的面容柔美，眉宇间散发着一抹喜色，声音柔和道：“当代的圣体传人前段时间找到我们，想要向你提亲，迎娶你为妻！”
此言一出。
正在打扫人皇庙宇的少女一愣，她回眸看向美妇人，蹙眉道：“师傅，我不是说了吗？”
“今生只愿征战帝路！”

“不会嫁人的！”
她的声音空灵清脆。
虽说听上去有些委婉，但却充满了坚定。
闻言。
美妇人叹息一声：
“小盈啊，如果是其他人的话，那我肯定帮你拒绝了，但是这次提亲的是圣体一脉传人……”
“圣体啊！”
“大成可叫板古之大帝！”
“而且那位圣体传人说了，待他圣体大成过后，他愿意为你护道，助你征战星空古路，成为荒古第一位女帝！”
少女的神色不变。
她声音淡然道：“何须他护道？难道没有人护道，我就不能成帝了吗？”
“你……”
美妇人有些无奈：“你这孩子怎么就这么犟呢，你口口声声说要证道，但你也不看看证道有多难？”
“近百万年来。”
“除了太古末年的那一位娲皇之外，还有哪位女子证道了？”
“况且。”
“你是先天道胎，这个体质虽说强大，但想要证道却也有点难度，古往今来也不是没有道胎诞生，但他们无一例外全都失败了……”
美妇人劝阻道：“你若是有一位大成圣体护道的话，今后证道的几率必然能够大大增加。”
闻言。
少女不语。

她自顾自的踮起脚清扫着人皇法相上那不存在的灰尘，仿佛压根没听见美妇人的言论。
见此。
美妇人有些生气了：“萧盈华！你真以为靠自己就能证道吗？自从十万年前恒宇大帝逝去过后，世间再无帝者诞生，唯有五尊无敌的大成圣体君临天下，没有大成圣体的扶持……”
“师傅！”
少女平静的转身。
content_en:
Ancient times.
The Human Emperor was born on the Beidou Emperor Burial Star.
He rose up in the most desperate era of the human race. He cultivated the two paths of yin and yang and evolved into the acquired chaotic body. In just over four hundred years, he reached the highest level in one fell swoop and proved the position of human emperor under the eyes of everyone——
So far.
The Beidou people have completely risen.
They regard the Human Emperor as the supreme god.
Temples of the Human Emperor have been built all over Beidou. Even in today's ancient times, no one can shake the belief in the Human Emperor.
In the hearts of the Beidou people——
The Human Emperor is a god!
A certain human emperor temple.
A girl who looks like an elf is cleaning everything in the temple. She is wearing a white dress. She has a graceful figure, tall and slender, with white and greasy skin. There seems to be endless starlight twinkling in her clear eyes, and she exudes a unique temperament...
Vaguely.
The girl seems to be in tune with the avenue.
Her every move exudes an indescribable aura, always in line with the great road, and attracting the closeness of the essence of heaven and earth.
"Xiaoying."
A dignified and beautiful woman walked in outside the temple.
Her face was soft and graceful, and there was a hint of joy between her brows. Her voice was soft and she said, "The contemporary heirs of the Holy Eucharist came to us some time ago and want to propose marriage to you and marry you!"
As soon as this statement came out.
The girl who was cleaning the Temple of the Human Emperor was stunned. She looked back at the beautiful woman and frowned: "Master, didn't I tell you?"
"In this life, I only want to fight on the imperial road!"
"I won't get married!"
Her voice is ethereal and clear.
Although it sounds a bit euphemistic, it is full of determination.
Hear the words.
The beautiful woman sighed:
"Xiaoying, if it were anyone else, I would definitely reject it for you, but this time the person proposing marriage is a descendant of the Holy Body lineage..."
"Holy body!"
"Dacheng can be called the Great Emperor of Bangu!"
"And the successor of the Holy Body said that after he reaches the completion of the Holy Body, he is willing to protect your path, help you conquer the ancient road in the starry sky, and become the first empress in ancient times!"
The girl's expression remained unchanged.
She said in a calm voice: "Why do I need him to protect the Tao? Can't I become the emperor without someone to protect the Tao?"
"You..."
The beautiful woman was a little helpless: "Why are you so stubborn, kid? You keep saying you want to attain enlightenment, but you don't see how difficult it is to attain enlightenment?"
"Nearly a million years."
"Aside from the Emperor Wa in the last years of ancient times, which other woman has attained enlightenment?"
"Besides."
"You are an innate Taoist fetus. Although your physique is powerful, it is still a bit difficult to achieve Taoism. There are no Taoist fetuses born throughout the ages, but they have all failed without exception..."
The beautiful woman dissuaded you: "If you have a Dacheng Holy Body to protect you, your chances of enlightenment will be greatly increased in the future."
Hear the words.
The girl was silent.
She was minding her own business, standing on tiptoes to clean the non-existent dust on the human emperor's Dharma image, as if she didn't hear the beautiful woman's words at all.
See this.
The beautiful woman was a little angry: "Xiao Yinghua! Do you really think you can achieve enlightenment on your own? Since the death of Emperor Hengyu a hundred thousand years ago, no emperor has been born in the world. Only the five invincible Dacheng Holy Bodies dominate the world. Without the support of the Dacheng Holy Bodies..."
"Master!"
The girl turned around calmly.
